summary: Walk a live product and find where the built interface has drifted from its design system, with inspectable evidence for each finding.

useCases.title: Find where the interface has drifted
useCases.message: Walk these pages and show me where the built interface has drifted from our design system. Cover the states and breakpoints, and group the findings by cause.

useCases.title: Find UI inconsistencies across the product
useCases.message: Click through these flows and record where components, spacing, color, and states are inconsistent with the rest of the product.
